{{Top}}
{{Quote|How many stormtroopers does it take to change a glow panel? Two: one to change it, and one to blast him, then take credit for the work.|Jacen Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
A '''glow panel''', also spelled '''glowpanel''', was a type of lighted panel that was used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to illuminate rooms and other types of enclosed spaces.
